summary: No new change this round: the red V33 log is identical to the one already diagnosed and fixed. Cause: config.spec.ts overwrites the whole machine-layer config.toml on the shared backend, removing [aicore.plugins.ext-demo], so the home query of ext-demo answered PLUGIN_UNAVAILABLE (the cached catalog still listed it). The fix is in the tree: e2e/backend.ts writes the config before start and exports GUI_E2E_CONFIG_FILE/GUI_E2E_CONFIG_TEXT; e2e/plugins.spec.ts rewrites that text in a beforeAll (line 40) so the extension is connected again whatever ran before. Verified by reading both files; not executed.
